Contract ManageLoanTermCRUDService::createLoanTerm(itemid: Integer,content: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		lt: LoanTerm = LoanTerm.allInstance()->any(o|o.ItemID = itemid and
		o.Content = content)
	precondition:
		true
	postcondition:
		if lt.oclIsUndefined() = true 
		then let newLt: LoanTerm in
		newLt.oclIsNew() and
		newLt.ItemID = itemid and
		newLt.Content = content and
		LoanTerm.allInstance()->includes(newLt) and
		result = true 
		else result = false 
		endif 
}
